description: Remove a file from a space's Files. A picture, clip or sound (media_id) goes to Trash, where it can be restored in the app for 30 days; it is refused while the space pins it, collects it, names it as an @element or has it on a roll prompt, and the refusal says where. An uploaded document (space_file_id) is deleted for good and comes off its pins, so it is refused until your human agrees: ask them, then call again with agreed: true.

agreed.description: A document only: true once your human agreed to delete it for good.

media_id.description: Instead: a picture, clip or sound from list_space media.

space_file_id.description: An uploaded document from list_space files.

space_id.description: The space whose Files hold it.

name: delete_file
title: Delete file
